title: Book Three · Chapter 62: Food After the Run
story:
On Saturday, Ronan makes a second pan of potatoes.

The first is for home. The second goes into a clean box with a tight lid.

Mum watches him put it in his bag.

“There will be some left for us?”

He points to the other pan.

“A whole meal. I know these customers.”

She smiles and lets him go. He takes the blue bike along the quiet streets, then pushes it at the busy corner.

At the park, Kai is already beneath the tree. He has bread and four small paper cups.

“For the water,” he says.

Ronan puts his bike beside the bench and takes out the box. Anna and Lin come along the path a few minutes later. Their cheeks are hot from the run.

Lin has oranges. Anna has apples and a clean cloth to spread under the food.

They wash their hands at the park tap and sit in the shade. Ronan opens the box.

Kai takes one potato piece and tries it.

He says nothing for a moment.

“Bad?” Ronan asks.

Kai takes another. “Very bad. Leave the box here.”

Anna laughs and reaches for her own piece. Lin opens the bread.

“Did your dad teach you?” Anna asks.

Ronan nods. “A few times. Now I can make it alone.”

The four sit with the food between them. There is no score and no unfinished page on the bench.

Kai tells them about his cousin's wooden car. It is under a cupboard now. All four wheels are still on it.

“So the car works,” Anna says.

“The driver is the problem.”

Ronan laughs. He nearly drops a piece of apple, then catches it against his shirt.

Anna points to the little wet mark.

“The shirt caught it.”

“A useful shirt.”

A small boy passes with his father. He looks at the open box. Kai quietly moves it closer to the middle.

“Your cousin?” Ronan asks.

“No. But I know that look.”

The boy and his father walk on. Anna shakes her head and takes the last potato piece before Kai can reach it.

“Customers first,” she tells Ronan.

“You are all customers.”

“Then a very busy cook.”

They share the oranges and put the peel in a paper bag. The empty box is lighter when Ronan closes it.

Kai needs to go home for a family lunch. Lin has a book to collect. Anna waits while Ronan wheels his bike onto the path.

“Good food,” she says.

“You can come again.”

“I need to run first.”

“I need to cook first.”

She smiles and steps beside him. They walk to the gate with the bike between them. At the crossing, she goes one way and he takes the road to the green door.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

tight lid＝盖得紧的盖子；spread＝铺开；peel＝果皮；customer＝顾客（这里是朋友间的玩笑）。

## 理解问题

1. 这次午间食物是不是全部由Ronan提供？其他朋友各自带了什么？
2. Kai说“很难吃”时，为什么又要把盒子留在自己旁边？

## 读句子

**The empty box is lighter when Ronan closes it.**

拆开看：The empty box / is lighter / when Ronan closes it.

空盒子／轻了不少／在Ronan把它盖上时。
